proposed.explanation: Elements operate throughout a building, not just externally. Elements include structural, enclosure, and opening elements. Elements are functional, not merely decorative. Ching defines elements as functional and formal components serving multiple simultaneous purposes. Every element (wall, column, window, passage) supports structure, organizes space, controls environment, and expresses design intention.
